levels.fhir-shaped: Uses FHIR R4-compatible TypeScript structures; profile validity is not implied.
levels.fhir-r4-validated: Core conversion logic has automated tests for documented FHIR R4 constraints.
levels.satusehat-mapped: Includes documented SATUSEHAT codes, systems, or extensions; full profile validation is not implied.
levels.satusehat-profile-validated: Validated against a named and versioned SATUSEHAT profile.
levels.demo-only: Includes mock data or an adapter contract and is not a live integration.

components.title: FHIR Address Input
limitations: Does not validate against a published StructureDefinition
Regional lookup defaults to mock data

components.title: FHIR Attachment Input
limitations: No automated size, MIME, accessibility, or round-trip tests

components.title: FHIR Birth Place Input
limitations: Profile validation is not implemented

components.title: FHIR Citizenship Status Input
limitations: Value-set conformance is not automatically verified

components.title: FHIR CodeableConcept Input
limitations: Terminology search must be supplied by the consumer
No expansion or code validation service is bundled

components.title: FHIR ContactPoint Input
limitations: Country-specific phone validation is not provided

components.title: FHIR Country Selector
limitations: Country list is bundled and requires maintenance

components.title: FHIR Date Input
limitations: Assistive-technology testing beyond automated axe checks is not yet documented

components.title: FHIR DateTime Input
limitations: Editing normalizes seconds to :00
UI exposes Indonesian offsets plus UTC

components.title: FHIR Dosage Input
limitations: Uses untyped intermediate construction in places
Dose rules are not clinically validated

components.title: FHIR Gender Input
limitations: Administrative gender is not a clinical sex or gender identity model

components.title: FHIR HumanName Input
limitations: Automatic name parsing is heuristic and locale-sensitive

components.title: FHIR Identifier Input
limitations: Format validation does not prove identity or registry membership

components.title: FHIR Location Input
limitations: Bundled API helper is a placeholder
Authentication and live SATUSEHAT calls are consumer responsibilities

components.title: FHIR Marital Status Input
limitations: Profile and value-set validation are not automated

components.title: FHIR Money Input
limitations: Currency precision and locale rules are not comprehensively tested

components.title: FHIR Odontogram Input
limitations: Public resource boundary still contains untyped values
Round-trip and profile tests are not yet implemented

components.title: FHIR Organization Input
limitations: Bundled search utilities use mock responses
Live MSI/FHIR authentication is not implemented

components.title: FHIR Period Input
limitations: Start-before-end constraints are not yet tested

components.title: FHIR Practitioner Input
limitations: Bundled search utilities use mock responses
Live authentication is not implemented

components.title: FHIR Quantity Input
limitations: Clinical ranges are guidance and not patient-specific decision support

components.title: FHIR Reference Input
limitations: Search and authorization must be supplied by the consumer

components.title: FHIR Regional Selector
limitations: Bundled data is illustrative
Production region data requires a maintained source

components.title: FHIR Religion Input
limitations: Value-set and profile validation are not automated

components.title: FHIR Vital Signs Input
limitations: Ranges are generic guidance, not clinical decision support
No external profile validator is run

components.title: Patient Registration Form
limitations: Practitioner usability has not yet been validated with field participants
Server validation, identity verification, consent, and duplicate matching remain consumer responsibilities
